subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: What should OpenClaw use as the durable, collector-visible `service.instance.id` source for diagnostics-otel exports?
rationale: The PR's correctness depends on a product/API choice about stable instance identity, privacy, and whether OpenClaw should introduce a new env contract or rely on the standard OTel resource path.

options.title: Align With Standard OTel Identity
options.body: Remove the new env knob and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` or a maintainer-approved OpenClaw identity seam.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` as an OpenClaw-supported input, but document precedence, privacy expectations, and upgrade behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Identity Design
options.body: Keep this PR paused while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071 settles the durable resource-identity contract.

recommendation.title: Align With Standard OTel Identity
recommendation.body: Remove the new env knob and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` or a maintainer-approved OpenClaw identity seam.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` introduced the diagnostics-otel exporter and is the strongest available history signal for deciding the exporter identity contract.
